title: Falling Stars
description: This project adds falling stars as datapack in Minecraft. These stars fall every 5 minutes and when they fell on the ground they do a random event and disappear.
body:
This project was made by me for fun, and just to check what I can do. It wasn't meant to be a serious project.

# Falling Stars
A datapack that adds some chaos into your world.

## Main loop
Star, summons every 5 minutes above random player and disappears after it landed on the ground
it summons random event after landing, also you can get this star if your gonna touch it before it lands

## Summoning stars
You can summon a star by dropping a soul sand into soul campfire, the star will be summoned above the campfire

**Check changelog for more information**
